title: 2013 Score #405 Matt Elam Baltimore Ravens Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2013 Score card features Matt Elam, a rookie player from the Baltimore Ravens team in the National Football League (NFL). The card is part of the base set and has the card number 405. It is a sports trading card manufactured by Panini in the category of Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop and Trading Card Singles.

This item is perfect for collectors who are interested in adding a piece of football history to their collection. It is a great addition to any sports trading card collection and will surely impress any fan of the Baltimore Ravens or Matt Elam. Get this card now and add it to your collection!
